name: 23569-longdecode-1b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; multiprocess (`mp`) executor with one worker process.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 40 requests / 900 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, prompts exactly 256 tokens and outputs exactly 2000 with ignore_eos, so every request is one prefill step then 1999 decode steps at batch size 1.
purpose: A long-form story writer turning short prompts into 2000-token narratives for a single reader on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine: commit c954c6629cdf4ebbfc1cab05d7d71af6696c5881 (v0.10.1rc1-517-gc954c6629cdf).
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct
dtype: bfloat16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
async-scheduling: true
distributed-executor-backend: mp
enable-prefix-caching: false

# Must stay ONE line of JSON: this file is read line by line and an indented block mapping
# would reach the engine as nothing at all.
compilation-config: {"full_cuda_graph": true}

# Pinned: an in-process engine otherwise falls through to 2048 / 128, a different server.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
